verdict.rationale: Synctera is a banking-as-a-service API platform, so a general automation capability is a fair question to ask, but the evidence documents no user-configurable automation or background-agent feature. Scheduled payments (synctera-docs-6) are a recurring payment feature for customers, not a general automation capability. Webhooks (synctera-docs-13, synctera-docs-23) only push event notifications to integrators and do not run actions autonomously. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
